name: Data.range_goodLift_le
summary: The good forms are the sum of their Hecke eigenparts; on each, e₀ is the sum of the tuple idempotents, and each term lies in N by hypothesis.

steps.claim: The range of goodLift is the image of the good forms; write the good forms as the supremum of their eigenparts (iSup_eigenPart): it suffices to show that the lift of each good eigenform lies in N.
steps.lean:
erw [range_domRestrict, ← range_comp, range_le_iff_comap, eq_top_iff, ← iSup_eigenPart,
    iSup_le_iff]

steps.claim: Take an eigensystem p and a form y of principal level in the eigenpart; its good part is e₀y.

θ_j^*(e₀y) = Σ_c θ_j^*(idem_c y) over the good tuples c, and each term lies in N by h: it is the lift of the good eigenform idem_c y (range_tupleIdem_le, principalRep_mem_eigenPart), and it lies in the range of the action of idem_c (groupAlgAction_auxLift).
steps.lean:
exact sum_mem fun c k ↦ h p _ ⟨D.range_tupleIdem_le k ⟨y, rfl⟩,
    principalRep_mem_eigenPart _ _ a _⟩ c k ⟨_, (D.groupAlgAction_auxLift y).symm⟩
